verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a no-code builder for multi-step automations such as triggers, conditions, or chained actions. Automatic Check-ins are a single scheduled-question feature, and templates only reuse project structure, so both are adjacent features. The REST API, CLI, and MCP support are developer building blocks that would require code. Automation is a fair axis for a project-management tool, so the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code
